the GOLF and GONG splittings are in agreement with the same level of uncertainty.
the solar internal rotation profile as derived from GOLF data is in good agreement with the MDI results and the GONG low degree results.
the GONG and GOLF splittings are compatible and that the internal solar rotation is not significantly different from the MDI rotation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have been able to determine a solar internal rotation profile with a good resolution down to the solar core.

the internal rotation profile is well determined in the outer radiative zone and that it is not possible to infer the rotation profile in the convective envelope with the present accuracy of the observations.
the internal rotation profile of the solar core, as derived from low degree splittings, is not yet well constrained and needs to be improved.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the GONG and GOLF low degree splittings are consistent within the uncertainties.
the internal solar rotation is well constrained by the GOLF data alone and the GONG data do not bring any additional information.
the GOLF splittings, when combined with MDI medium l splittings, are sufficient to infer the solar rotation down to $0,2 R_\odot$ with a resolution of about 0.01 R_\odot.
